review_type: Direct actual-native-frame author review; separate from numerical and source/unit acceptance.
scope: Bounded visual PASS for all 24 native 640x400 shadow captures (P2/P4/P7/P11, ticks 38-43), each directly compared with its retained head-only reference. Eligible shadows are smoother and narrower at the original offset; slender, diagonal, fan and twin heads remain readable and distinct. The fixed-window acceptance retains clipping/fallback and occlusion limits, including legitimate P7/P11 composited head-pixel changes. These are controlled SDL dummy/software captures, not Windows or manual-play testing.
method: Each full frame was opened individually at original resolution and in frame order with its paired retained head-only reference. No resized sheet, synthetic composition or source-art preview was used as actual-runtime evidence.

findings.p2: Narrow 201/202 silhouettes keep their original underside offset with smoother contours. Bright slender heads remain legible over clouds, cloud edges and dark ground.
findings.p4: 163/164 diagonal shots remain distinct from the unchanged central shot. Admitted shadows are thin, smooth diagonals without a new blocky patch or visual head loss. Edge-clipped guarded calls remain classic.
findings.p7: 121/122 fan heads remain broader than P2/P4. New shadow silhouettes follow their orientation at the original offset without overwhelming the bright core. The 32 head-support changes remain legitimate compositing effects.
findings.p11: 279/280 twins remain distinguishable alongside the broader fan and original central shots, including the bounded dense near-ship volleys. The 111 head-support changes remain legitimate overlap effects.

limits: Direct visual scope is exactly 24 shadow BMPs and 24 corresponding retained head-only BMPs: P2, P4, P7, P11; ticks 38-43; native 640x400. Each full frame was opened individually at original resolution, in frame order, with its corresponding reference. No resized sheet, synthetic composition or source-art preview was used as actual-runtime visual evidence.

These are genuine captured SDL dummy/software renderer outputs with controlled diagnostic input. This is not a Windows run, physical-display inspection, manual gameplay, live power acquisition, or general playability certification.

Visual acceptance does not establish exact alpha composition or gameplay parity. Those remain separately supported by the pinned source/unit/numerical receipts. This reviewer did not rerun builds, units, runtime cases or capture windows.
Guarded horizontal/vertical fallback remains deliberate: six-frame windows contain P2=0, P4=10, P7=9, P11=9 guarded target shadow calls. Old contours at those guards are not claimed to be upgraded.

Not every member is fully visible in every frame: viewport cropping, later draws and normal overlap remain. Per-ID fractional/unique witnesses are window-level, not a promise of a changed visible pixel for every ID in every capture.

All eight head assets/alpha and normal-head draw decisions are unchanged according to the pinned source/runtime reports. Final composited head RGB is not globally identical: P7/P11 include 143 legitimate changed head-support pixels. Exact zero differences outside allowed support and exact zero opaque-head-erasure violations are separate numerical results.

Existing 58/59 and enemy-role operators are not changed by this route. Their final pixels may still be affected by permitted shadow underlay/overdraw at intersections; this sparse scene does not establish full enemy-role occlusion coverage.

Only the fixed four powers and this six-frame scene window are aesthetically accepted. No claim is made about other powers, levels, scales, later animation, platforms, dense enemy encounters or unseen collision/occlusion cases.
public_payload: Sanitized hashes, counts and findings only; no original data, decoded reference arrays, capture pixels, screenshots, private paths or Library identifiers.
